description: Use this when the user wants class diagram text checked without a drawing, for example "check my class diagram for errors" or "are there inheritance cycles in this model". Takes the same text as make_class_diagram. Returns the syntax problems with their line numbers, relations to classes that are not declared, duplicate classes and members, inheritance cycles named class by class, and model warnings (abstract members in a concrete class, a class that inherits from an interface, realization of a class that is not an interface, repeated relations). Draws nothing and makes no files. Does not read source code files.
name: check_class_diagram
title: Check class diagram text
